title: Efficient Multiscale Methods for Highly Heterogeneous Spatial Network Models
summary: Modeling complex spatial networks with multiscale heterogeneity poses significant mathematical and computational challenges. Lacking explicit PDE discretizations and facing excessive degrees of freedom, conventional methods often become computationally prohibitive. To address these challenges, we propose an efficient multiscale modeling for highly heterogeneous spatial networks. We construct multiscale basis functions tailored to spatial network models with heterogeneous edge weights and node degrees.
